author: Totally Not Mark
description:
Dragon Ball Super: Beerus' third episode has ignited the fandom on fire by deleting Vegeta's takoyaki moment. Not even the slightest hint at its bingo origins remain. I'm not here to tell you how to feel about it, but I am here to tell Toei Animation to pick a lane. Cater to everyone and you cater to no one. 

Also, yes, Goku didn't know what a kiss was. That is not a mistranslation.  https://www.kanzenshuu.com/rumor/goku-never-kissed/
title: Dragon Ball FANS aren’t the problem. It’s TOEI.
